analyst_view.overall: Lille are 35th with 1 point from 4 games after losing 1-0 at home to Lyon, so this is close to their last chance of the play-offs, while Bayern are 14th with 8. Lille miss Tiago Santos, Igamane and Nianzou (all counted), and today's injury list also has striker Ayase Ueda out with his foot injury, which the numbers don't list; Ethan Mbappe returns from a ban. Bayern are badly hit: Kane, Olise, Neuer, Davies, Gnabry and Saibari are out and counted, Luis Diaz and Ndiaye are also listed out, and Kompany said Musiala and Diaz are not options to start, so a young attack around Lennart Karl and Brown is expected. Italian referee Marco Guida (about 3.6 cards a game) is named and already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals, already cutting Bayern hard for Kane (-15%), Olise (-14%) and Gnabry and Lille for Igamane. They can't see Musiala and Diaz not starting for Bayern or Lille losing Ueda up front, so both attacks are weaker than the numbers think; I lean lower, to about 2.3.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, close to even. Bayern will still have plenty of the ball and push full-backs up, and Lille must attack at home, so I stay at 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.0 cards, already taking off for Guida's lowish record and Bayern's calm recent run. Lille's desperation could add a foul or two, but nothing specific points that way, so I stay at 3.0.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.2 shots (10.3 Lille, 14.9 Bayern), and they only take Bayern's absences off goals, not shots. Without Kane, Olise, Musiala and Diaz in the starting side Bayern lose most of their usual shooters, and Lille lose Ueda, so I cut to about 23.4.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 on target. A young Bayern attack and a Lille side without Ueda and Igamane should create fewer clean chances than usual, so I lean lower, to about 8.5.
